source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For user authentication, we should use a hybrid model so the platform remains accessible to crypto and non-crypto users alike (the fiat on-ramp is crucial for virality):
[ACCOUNT_001] Use wallet auth (SIWE) for crypto flows, since it is required for mints/transfers.
[ACCOUNT_001] Use email-based auth to access the dashboard (referrals, tickets, prizes), connecting fiat users who do not have wallets.
[ACCOUNT_001] Keep public APIs unauthenticated (e.g., leaderboards, pool values) so they stay open and transparent.

This fits our lean MVP: non-crypto users can mint through Stripe/email, while crypto users can do so through their wallet. Keep the email implementation simple, such as magic links for minimal friction.

For the email provider, we'll use Brevo—I’ll open the account and send the credentials soon. I’m okay with the paid Starter plan if it meaningfully improves UX or deliverability, provided it is worth the price.

For Stripe, I’ll set up a test account and share the details shortly—concentrate on fiat to USDC for now. As above, if an inexpensive paid add-on improves reliability/UX, we can discuss it; the free tier is fine initially.

I have just corrected the Senders & IPs settings.
Your BREVO\_SENDER\_EMAIL ends with the ...@[URL_002] domain name.

Therefore, I configured it as BREVO\_SENDER\[EMAIL_003]
It is working properly now.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just completed a purchase using USDC:
The purchase succeeded in one transaction, although there was no 'mint successful' popup.
I also received emails about:
- new badge - 'Medal'
- new badge - 'Hustler'
- new badge - 'High Roller'
- new badge - 'First Referral'
- Referral earnings - Earnings $5, Total referrals 2

However, 'first referral' is the only badge ticked on my dashboard, and the NFT is still not appearing.

execution.observed_behavior: Client received multiple badge and referral-earnings transactional emails after a USDC purchase, confirming successful email delivery.

routing_warnings.description: The inaccurate badge and referral-notification contents belong to reward-notification accuracy, while their successful receipt supports Brevo delivery.
Notifications for badges the client had not earned concern reward-notification triggering and accuracy.
The missing email-registration confirmation concerns email verification and dashboard authentication rather than provider-level Brevo configuration.
The displayed verified-email state concerns email authentication and registration state rather than Brevo delivery configuration.
